channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Trae Young | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Trae Young from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Khris Middleton, Deandre Ayton, Trae Young
item.description:
“A lot of No. 1 picks come into a situation where they are ‘The Guy’ (and) everything’s kind of centered around them. But I have All-Star Hall-of-Famers on my team that I can (learn) under and get some knowledge from: Khris Middleton, Trae Young, AD and Deandre Ayton. So I don’t have to come in and carry this huge load. I think I can just bond with these guys and learn it slowly and learn how to play the right way.”

AJ Dybantsa on Khris Middleton, Deandre Ayton, Trae Young, Sep 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Will Dawkins on Trae Young
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Wizards General Manager Will Dawkins on Trae Young:

“Trae made an immediate impact on our organization and the DMV when he arrived in January. Re-signing one of the league’s premier point guards was a top priority for usthis offseason as we continue to build here in D.C.”

Will Dawkins on Trae Young, Jul 8, 2026. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Davis, Trae Young
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa:

“The Wizards haven't been to the playoffs in some time, so I just want to make the playoffs year one. I think we have the team to do it, getting Anthony Davis, getting Trae Young and having our young core. But ultimate goal is I'll start getting D-Wade, I always wanted to be a Hall of Famer, but he says the goal I should have is to be a top 100 player. So I think 20 years from now, I answer the league 20 years from now, it will be the 100-year anniversary of the NBA. And you know, like top 75, they bring the 75 best players, I always says when they bring the 100 players out, that should be my goal instead of just being a Hall of Famer.”

AJ Dybantsa on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Davis, Trae Young, Jun 29, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Trae Young
item.description:
[Finlay]AJ Dybantsa on taking Trae Young's #3 jersey number:

“I was trolling about but... if he wants to give me the number I'll take the number”

AJ Dybantsa on Trae Young, Jun 24, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Michael Winger on Trae Young
item.description:
Michael Winger on Trae Young’s defense:

“He’ll be the first to tell you he’s not a humongous athlete. He gives up size on the defensive end. But he’ll play with effort,he’ll play with intelligence…But he’s not a shot-blocker and guys could potentially bully him…but that’s okay because that puts more pressure on Alex and we don’t mind the pressure on Alex. That puts more pressure on Bilal, that’s fine, we want that pressure on those guys.”

Michael Winger on Trae Young, May 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Winger on Trae Young
item.description:
MoreMichael Winger on why they traded for Trae Young:

“He’s an absolute genius. He’s a savant with the basketball in his hands..up until that point, other players on the floor have had to create for themselves and others and we don’t have a pure natural playmaker. We struggle offensively to create because we don’t have someone as naturally gifted as he is at creating something. He’s an offensive engine, we lacked an offensive engine. We have great play finishers, we have great athletes but we didn’t have an offensive engine.”

Michael Winger on Trae Young, May 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Trae Young
item.description:
“I talked briefly (Friday) with Will. Obviously, at this time, every year, you want to compete for championships and stuff like that. That’s obviously the main focus, getting to that place. Conversations are going to be held to see about getting to that space. I’ve been everywhere the last two years. I want to see the plan, hear the plan, see the vision. Bringing Trae (Young) here and other things in store, what they’re thinking of doing, I want to have those conversations with them and see what happens. The city is obviously phenomenal.”

Anthony Davis on Trae Young, Feb 6, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Onsi Saleh on CJ McCollum, Trae Young, Corey Kispert
item.description:
Atlanta Hawks GM Onsi Saleh on trading Trae Young for CJ McCollum and Corey Kispert:

“On behalf of the Hawks franchise, I’d like to thank Trae for how he embraced the city of Atlanta and represented the Hawks during his time here, on the court and in the community. Over more than seven seasons, including four All-Star appearances, he cemented himself as a fan favorite and one of the great players in our franchise’s history. We wish Trae and his family all the best.”

Onsi Saleh on CJ McCollum, Trae Young, Corey Kispert, Jan 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Trae Young
item.description:
MrBuckBuck:Former GM Ryan McDonough on the Trae Young situation:

“One of the hard things for an organization is when a player and his agent are pushing, saying ‘let us talk to the other 29 teams’ and as the GM, you have to play it coy while thinking ‘Well, I know what they think about him…”

Ryan McDonough on Trae Young, Jan 7, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Trae Young
item.description:
Pat Beverley:

“Yeah. It threw me off. I’m a huge advocate for Trae Young and what he’s done on the basketball court. ButI’ve talked to guys who’ve played in Atlanta. And they don’t want to play there.”

Patrick Beverley on Trae Young, Sep 17, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JJ Redick on Trae Young
item.description:
“I’ll reference the Oklahoma City game where he made a mistake at the end and we play a week later in Atlanta and he’s in sort of the same situation at the end of regulation and he gets a block on Trae Young. With young guys these opportunities are great for them to grow not only confidence but also just the learned experience of our knowledge of being in different situations.”

JJ Redick on Trae Young, Dec 16, 2024. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Trae Young
item.description:
Quin Snyder:

“I'm not going to get into the specifics of (Trae Young's injury), but obviously he's out tonight and we gotta figure out how to, without him and a number of guys... how to play well and compete ... he's a big part of what we do and he's the engine, so it's an opportunity for other guys to collectively come together and try to generate offense as much as anything without him. A lot of times, ironically, that means getting stops and playing defense and trying to get out in the open floor.”

Quin Snyder on Trae Young, Nov 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Trey Alexander on Dejounte Murray, Trae Young
item.description:
Trey Alexander:

“I watch a lot of Dejounte Murray. Kind of those guys that play the two-way spot. They have the ball in their hands, but they also play with good guards. Obviously, he plays with Trae Young, he has to be able to be that second option, so that’s kinda a guy that I watch a lot of film on.”

Trey Alexander on Dejounte Murray, Trae Young, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Draymond Green on Domantas Sabonis, Trae Young
item.description:
“The Kings are currently at fifth in the West and have been in the top four most of the year, which means [they’re] very much in the playoffs, right there next to home-court advantage in the first round. But they’re in fifth. [Fox’s averaging] 27 and five. Domantas Sabonis is averaging 19.9 points -- so we’re just going to give him 20 -- 13 rebounds and eight assists, and the Kings are in fifth place. “Now that’s interesting because in a stat-driven league, we have the tale of two tapes which is one team right on the brink of the playoffs, another team that is firmly in the playoff picture right now, all three [including Trae Young] with incredible stats, none make the All-Star Game.”

Draymond Green on Domantas Sabonis, Trae Young, Feb 6, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Trae Young
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Mark Daigneault on Trae Young's foul drawing:

“Once he's got you at his mercy, he really knows how to initiate contact. I thought most of those were fouls. He does a really good job of selling those plays.”

Mark Daigneault on Trae Young, Jan 3, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Trae Young
item.description:
Jeff Schultz:Dejounte Murray on the struggling Trae Young:

“He has to be confident, be Trae Young, be who he is. Keep the outside noise outside. I texted him when we got home. I just told him, 'Be yourself, play the game you want to play, and play it at a high level like you’re used to doing”

Dejounte Murray on Trae Young, Apr 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @JeffSchultzATL.

item.title: Ben Simmons on Trae Young
item.description:
Ben Simmons on passing up dunk against Trae Young:

“If I could go back I would go up strong, go to the line,”

Ben Simmons on Trae Young, Nov 6, 2022. Source: Sydney Morning Herald.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Trae Young
item.description:
Christos Tsaltas:Dejounte Murray on playing alongside Trae Young:

“He wanted to play with me, I want to play with him. We know each other for a while. It's something we both want it”

Dejounte Murray on Trae Young, Jul 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @Tsaltas46.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Trae Young
item.description:
Heat coach ErikSpoelstra credited Young (24 points, seven rebounds, four assists) for coming through when the Hawks needed it.

“Young got a little bit of an angle and he was able to make a tough runner,”

Erik Spoelstra on Trae Young, Apr 23, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Trae Young
item.description:
Kyle Lowry on Trae Young:

“He’s gonna make more than 1 shot. He’s gonna have more than 4 assists. He’s gonna explode, but we gotta stay patient and stick to what we do.”

Kyle Lowry on Trae Young, Apr 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Trae Young, Tyler Herro
item.description:
Barry Jackson:Haslem on Herro:

“People were like, ‘I was crazy to co-sign Tyler being in the conversation with Luka and Trae Young.’ People thought I was crazy to co-sign. I was like, ‘I’m not crazy. I know what I see.'”

Udonis Haslem on Trae Young, Tyler Herro, Mar 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Trae Young
item.description:
Nate McMillan on Trae Young being named an All-Star starter:

“I think he deserves to be there. He’s been playing as an All-Star and they rewarded him with an opportunity to start. I think it’s great.”

Nate McMillan on Trae Young, Jan 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Chris Fleming on Trae Young
item.description:
Julia Poe:Chris Fleming on Trae Young being cleared to face the Bulls tonight:

“You want to play against the best players and I think that's how we get better. ... I'm happy to hear he's on the floor tonight.”

Chris Fleming on Trae Young, Dec 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Trae Young
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Nate McMillan on Trae Young:

“It was good to see that ball go in for us, and he came out very aggressive. He felt a rhythm, and just stayed with it.”

Nate McMillan on Trae Young, Nov 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Trae Young
item.description:
Cavs coachJB Bickerstaff on Trae Young:

“We know he's great at drawing fouls, and when he adds FTs to his scoring and playmaking, it's a nightmare for you,so we have to do a great job of being physical with him but staying between him and the basket as much as we possibly can.”

JB Bickerstaff on Trae Young, Oct 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Trae Young
item.description:
Colangelo on Trae Young:

“I’m happy that he wants to play for USA Basketball. We had him in one of our camps. We know him in USA Basketball. He’s done really well in the NBA.But predicated on what we felt we needed, he didn’t fit the bill this time around. He’s a young player, he has a future with USA Basketball but it was the opinion of our staff that it wasn’t now. It’s for others to make the declaration ‘you made a mistake.’”

Jerry Colangelo on Trae Young, Jul 30, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Trae Young
item.description:
Nate McMillan on Trae Young:

“It’s not anything that is long term. He has had pain that is not comfortable enough for him to get out there and feel like he can help the team.”

Nate McMillan on Trae Young, Jul 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @CVivlamoreAJC.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Trae Young
item.description:
Nate McMillan on if there's any concern with Trae Young's injury moving forward:

“I don't know right now. I think, when he returned to the floor, he was obviously limping on that, and when I subbed him, we decided just keep him out.”

Nate McMillan on Trae Young, Jun 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Trae Young
item.description:
Hawks coachNate McMillan on Trae Young:

“Trae is going to be fine. He had some bad turnovers. Some of those, we were just throwing them to the defense. They did a good job of being more aggressive in their pick-and-roll coverage, and we had one of those nights.”

Nate McMillan on Trae Young, Jun 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Trae Young
item.description:
Chris Vivlamore:Jrue Holiday on guarding Trae Young:

“Me, I think I can be more aggressive. Sometimes going against someone like Trae, who is a bit lighter, who initiates the contact and gets those calls, it’s hard to guard. I got six fouls. I’ve got to play smarter.”

Jrue Holiday on Trae Young, Jun 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @CVivlamoreAJC.
